title: Deal path
lead: The client sees the same steps, except the hidden ones. Record each step when it happens.
preview: Nothing recorded yet. These steps are created from the template when the terms are agreed, or with your first action here.

complete.title: Complete the deal
complete.lead: Every step is done or not needed. Confirm the deed or lease date to close the deal as completed.
complete.reviewed: I checked every step on this path and the date above.
complete.boundary: Completing closes the deal with a recorded outcome the client sees. It does not certify a legal transfer, and the listing's status is changed separately.

blocked.terms_not_agreed: The terms are not agreed yet.
blocked.final_step_open: The last step must be done, not marked as not needed.
